notes: Continuous research mission. Run scheduled research only between 08:00 and 16:00 Europe/Berlin, with no practical lead-count cap. Research only: never send messages, submit forms, create accounts, log in, or contact businesses. Use public data only. Never guess emails. HARD EXCLUSION: never research, qualify, approve or hand off lawyers, attorneys, law firms, notaries, patent attorneys, tax advisers/tax consultancies, auditors or similar legal/regulated advisory professions for outreach. No CAPTCHA or security bypass. Prefer quality over count. A-Leads require at least two verified optimization signals and digital readiness. Website services are only service-visibility candidates until final QA; never claim a Google Business Profile service gap without verification. Prefer direct local competitors from the same query. Record ranking position, purchase-likelihood, contact quality, confidence, why-now and evidence. Reject obvious chains and stale/invalid businesses where detectable. ChatGPT performs final QA and Airtable sync.
